primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

review.identityCheckJa: 14:21,31でレハブアムの母とされるナアマ。創世記などに登場する同名人物とは別人。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 常時表示欄は初出時点で確認できる内容に限り、後の出来事は個別の節を示すfactsに分けた。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: L114 identifies Naamah as mother of Rehoboam and explicitly cites 1 Kings 14:21–31. The note retains only the relation named in the assigned-book text and avoids further traditions in L115–117.
